_comment: Security Policy module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_note: Agent applies the new Whitelist and Sandbox path into RAM immediately upon receiving a policy_update, overriding local config.

policy_update._desc: Push a new security policy (whitelist & sandbox path) to one or more agents

policy_update_result._desc: Agent confirms the result of applying a policy_update command
policy_update_result.message: Policy updated successfully on memory and disk
